ayahs.translation: By the dawn,
and the ten nights,
and the even and the odd,
and by the night when it departs.

ayahs.arabicText: هَلْ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِیْ حِجْرٍؕ
ayahs.translation: Is there in this an oath for one endowed with understanding?

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَمْ تَرَ كَیْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ۪ۙ
ayahs.translation: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with Ad
of Iram, known for their lofty columns,

ayahs.arabicText: الَّتِیْ لَمْ یُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِی الْبِلَادِ۪ۙ
ayahs.translation: the like of whom no nation was ever created in the lands of the world?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ ثَمُوْدَ الَّذِیْنَ جَابُوا الصَّخْرَ بِالْوَادِ۪ۙ
ayahs.translation: And how did He deal with Thamud who hewed out rocks in the valley?
And with Pharaoh of the tent pegs
who transgressed in the countries of the world
spreading in them much corruption?
Then their Lord unloosed upon them the lash of chastisement.
Truly your Lord is ever watchful.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَمَّا الْاِنْسَانُ اِذَا مَا ابْتَلٰىهُ رَبُّهٗ فَاَكْرَمَهٗ وَ نَعَّمَهٗ١ۙ۬ فَیَقُوْلُ رَبِّیْۤ اَكْرَمَنِؕ
ayahs.translation: As for man, when his Lord tests him by exalting him and bestowing His bounties upon him, he says: “My Lord has exalted me.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَمَّاۤ اِذَا مَا ابْتَلٰىهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَیْهِ رِزْقَهٗ١ۙ۬ فَیَقُوْلُ رَبِّیْۤ اَهَانَنِۚ
ayahs.translation: But when He tests him by straitening his sustenance, he says: “My Lord has humiliated me.”
But no; you do not treat the orphan honourably,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا تَحٰٓضُّوْنَ عَلٰى طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِیْنِۙ
ayahs.translation: and do not urge one another to feed the poor,
and greedily devour the entire inheritance,
and love the riches, loving them ardently.

ayahs.arabicText: كَلَّاۤ اِذَا دُكَّتِ الْاَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّاۙ
ayahs.translation: But no; when the earth is ground to powder,

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ جَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَ الْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّاۚ
ayahs.translation: and when your Lord appears with rows upon rows of angels,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جِایْٓءَ یَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ١ۙ۬ یَوْمَئِذٍ یَّتَذَكَّرُ الْاِنْسَانُ وَ اَنّٰى لَهُ الذِّكْرٰىؕ
ayahs.translation: and when Hell is brought near that Day. On that Day will man understand, but of what avail will that understanding be?
He will say: “Would that I had sent ahead what would be of avail for this life of mine!”
Then on that Day Allah will chastise as none other can chastise;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ لَا یُوْثِقُ وَ ثَاقَهٗۤ اَحَدٌؕ
ayahs.translation: and Allah will bind as none other can bind.
(On the other hand it will be said): “O serene soul!
Return to your Lord well-pleased (with your blissful destination), well-pleasing (to your Lord).
So enter among My (righteous) servants
and enter My Paradise.”
